title: Being smart is not the hard part. Keeping score is.
voice_draft: macOS say, Daniel (en_GB), rate 172. Replace with an AI voice by setting VOICE_PROVIDER in media/short-01/README.md

caption: COUNTED
TWICE?
scenes.line: Everyone is selling carbon credits. Almost nobody can show you which ones were counted twice.

caption: 26 SETS
OF BOOKS
scenes.line: There are about twenty six registries. Each keeps its own books. One tonne can turn up in two of them.

caption: ONE
REGISTER
scenes.line: So we built CarbonLedger. Not a new chain. One register on Solana, where every gram gets a serial number, and can be retired once.

caption: RULES LIVE
IN FILES
scenes.line: Here is the part nobody shows you. The rules do not live in a chatbot. They live in files. The same ten test cases run against the server, the database, and the program on chain.

caption: CHECK IT
YOURSELF
scenes.line: Every retirement gets a receipt, sealed to the one before it. One fingerprint of the whole batch goes on Solana. Anyone can check it, without trusting us.

caption: CLEAR THE
SMALLEST FIRST
scenes.line: Then it becomes a game. Every gram is a point. Together, we clear the smallest country first. Right now, that is Kiribati.

caption: KEEPING
SCORE
scenes.line: The machine is smart. Keeping score honestly is the hard part. CarbonLedger.
